It causes bradykinin accumulation, leading to the swelling of various tissus, including upper airway. results.text: A Rare Case of Idiopathic Angioedema Associated With Amlodipine Use. Angioedema is a self-limited, non-pitting edema of subcutaneous or submucosal tissues often affecting the face, lips, oral cavity, and airway. It may be histamine or bradykinin-mediated and is most commonly triggered by allergic reactions, medications, or systemic conditions.
